theorems.name: Submission.tdo_stp_infDist_le_infDist_add_hsNorm
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (P Q : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)) (x : Amb n ℓ), infDist x (P : Set (Amb n ℓ)) ≤ infDist x (Q : Set (Amb n ℓ)) + hsNorm (P.starProjection - Q.starProjection) * ‖x‖
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
